005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Seconds;
008import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
009
010import java.util.ArrayDeque;
011import java.util.ArrayList;
012import java.util.Deque;
013import java.util.EnumMap;
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.Map;
016import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
017import org.wpilib.event.EventLoop;
018import org.wpilib.math.filter.Debouncer;
019import org.wpilib.system.Timer;
020import org.wpilib.units.measure.Time;
021
022/**
023 * Triggers allow users to specify conditions for when commands should run. Triggers can be set up
024 * to read from joystick and controller buttons (eg {@link
025 * org.wpilib.command3.button.CommandGamepad#faceDown()}) or be customized to read sensor values or
026 * any other arbitrary true/false condition.
027 *
028 * <p>It is very easy to link a button to a command. For instance, you could link the trigger button
029 * of a joystick to a "score" command.
030 *
031 * <p>Triggers can easily be composed for advanced functionality using the {@link
032 * #and(BooleanSupplier)}, {@link #or(BooleanSupplier)}, {@link #negate()} operators.
033 *
034 * <p>Trigger bindings created inside a running command will only be active while that command is
035 * running. This is useful for defining trigger-based behavior only in a certain scope and avoids
036 * needing to create dozens of global triggers. Any commands scheduled by these triggers will be
037 * canceled when the enclosing command exits.
038 *
039 * <pre>{@code
040 * Command shootWhileAiming = Command.noRequirements(co -> {
041 *   turret.atTarget.onTrue(shooter.shootOnce());
042 *   co.await(turret.lockOnGoal());
043 * }).named("Shoot While Aiming");
044 * controller.rightBumper().whileTrue(shootWhileAiming);
045 * }</pre>
046 */
047public class Trigger implements BooleanSupplier {
048  private final BooleanSupplier m_condition;
049  private final EventLoop m_loop;
050  private final Scheduler m_scheduler;
051
052  /** The value of the signal before the most recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null. */
053  private Signal m_previousSignal;
054
055  /** The value of the signal from the most recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null. */
056  private Signal m_cachedSignal;
057
058  private final Map<BindingType, List<Binding>> m_bindings = new EnumMap<>(BindingType.class);
059  private final Runnable m_eventLoopCallback = this::poll;
060  private boolean m_bound = true;
061  private final BindingScope m_creationScope;
062
063  /**
064   * Represents the state of a signal: high or low. Used instead of a boolean for nullity on the
065   * first run, when the previous signal value is undefined and unknown.
066   */
067  enum Signal {
068    /** The signal is high. */
069    HIGH,
070    /** The signal is low. */
071    LOW
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition. Polled by the scheduler's {@link
076   * Scheduler#getDefaultEventLoop() default event loop}.
077   *
078   * @param scheduler The scheduler that should execute triggered commands.
079   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
080   */
081  public Trigger(Scheduler scheduler, BooleanSupplier condition) {
082    this(
083        requireNonNullParam(scheduler, "scheduler", "Trigger"),
084        scheduler.getDefaultEventLoop(),
085        requireNonNullParam(condition, "condition", "Trigger"));
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition. Triggered commands are executed by the
090   * {@link Scheduler#getDefault() default scheduler}.
091   *
092   * <p>Polled by the default scheduler button loop.
093   *
094   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
095   */
096  public Trigger(BooleanSupplier condition) {
097    this(Scheduler.getDefault(), condition);
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Creates a new trigger based on the given condition.
102   *
103   * @param scheduler The scheduler that should execute triggered commands.
104   * @param loop The event loop to poll the trigger.
105   * @param condition the condition represented by this trigger
106   */
107  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
108  public Trigger(Scheduler scheduler, EventLoop loop, BooleanSupplier condition) {
109    m_scheduler = requireNonNullParam(scheduler, "scheduler", "Trigger");
110    m_loop = requireNonNullParam(loop, "loop", "Trigger");
111    m_condition = requireNonNullParam(condition, "condition", "Trigger");
112    m_creationScope = BindingScope.createNarrowestScope(m_scheduler);
113
114    m_scheduler.addBoundTrigger(this);
115    m_loop.bind(m_eventLoopCallback);
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * Starts the given command whenever the condition changes from `false` to `true`.
120   *
121   * @param command the command to start
122   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
123   */
124  public Trigger onTrue(Command command) {
125    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onTrue");
126    addBinding(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_RISING_EDGE, command);
127    return this;
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Starts the given command whenever the condition changes from `true` to `false`.
132   *
133   * @param command the command to start
134   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
135   */
136  public Trigger onFalse(Command command) {
137    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "onFalse");
138    addBinding(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_FALLING_EDGE, command);
139    return this;
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `true` and cancels it when the condition
144   * changes to `false`.
145   *
146   * <p>Unlike {@link #retryWhileTrue(Command)}, this does <strong>not</strong> restart the command
147   * if it ends while the condition is still `true`.
148   *
149   * @param command the command to start
150   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
151   */
152  public Trigger whileTrue(Command command) {
153    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "whileTrue");
154    addBinding(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_HIGH, command);
155    return this;
156  }
157
158  /**
159   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `false` and cancels it when the
160   * condition changes to `true`.
161   *
162   * <p>Unlike {@link #retryWhileFalse(Command)}, this does <strong>not</strong> restart the command
163   * if it ends while the condition is still `false`.
164   *
165   * @param command the command to start
166   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
167   */
168  public Trigger whileFalse(Command command) {
169    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "whileFalse");
170    addBinding(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_LOW, command);
171    return this;
172  }
173
174  /**
175   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `true` and cancels it when the condition
176   * changes to `false`.
177   *
178   * <p>Unlike {@link #whileTrue(Command)}, the command is restarted if it ends while the condition
179   * is still `true`. If the command stopped because it was interrupted, restarting it will
180   * immediately interrupt the would-be interrupting command (if they have the same priority).
181   *
182   * @param command the command to start
183   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
184   */
185  public Trigger retryWhileTrue(Command command) {
186    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "retryWhileTrue");
187    addBinding(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH, command);
188    return this;
189  }
190
191  /**
192   * Starts the given command when the condition changes to `false` and cancels it when the
193   * condition changes to `true`.
194   *
195   * <p>Unlike {@link #whileFalse(Command)}, the command is restarted if it ends while the condition
196   * is still `false`. If the command stopped because it was interrupted, restarting it will
197   * immediately interrupt the would-be interrupting command (if they have the same priority).
198   *
199   * @param command the command to start
200   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
201   */
202  public Trigger retryWhileFalse(Command command) {
203    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "retryWhileFalse");
204    addBinding(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_LOW, command);
205    return this;
206  }
207
208  /**
209   * Toggles a command when the condition changes from `false` to `true`.
210   *
211   * @param command the command to toggle
212   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
213   */
214  public Trigger toggleOnTrue(Command command) {
215    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "toggleOnTrue");
216    addBinding(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_RISING_EDGE, command);
217    return this;
218  }
219
220  /**
221   * Toggles a command when the condition changes from `true` to `false`.
222   *
223   * @param command the command to toggle
224   * @return this trigger, so calls can be chained
225   */
226  public Trigger toggleOnFalse(Command command) {
227    requireNonNullParam(command, "command", "toggleOnFalse");
228    addBinding(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_FALLING_EDGE, command);
229    return this;
230  }
231
232  /**
233   * Gets the boolean state of the trigger. Because triggers are checked when their event loop is
234   * polled, which by default occurs when {@link Scheduler#run()} is called in user code, but may
235   * differ for custom event loops, the state is only valid immediately after the event loop is
236   * polled. If the underlying signal changes without a subsequent event loop poll, the return value
237   * from {@code getAsBoolean()} may not agree with the result of checking the signal directly.
238   *
239   * <p>This method will always return {@code false} before being polled by an event loop.
240   *
241   * @return The state of the trigger.
242   */
243  @Override
244  public boolean getAsBoolean() {
245    return m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH;
246  }
247
248  /**
249   * Composes two triggers with logical AND.
250   *
251   * @param trigger the condition to compose with
252   * @return A trigger which is active when both component triggers are active.
253   */
254  public Trigger and(BooleanSupplier trigger) {
255    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> getAsBoolean() && trigger.getAsBoolean());
256  }
257
258  /**
259   * Composes two triggers with logical OR.
260   *
261   * @param trigger the condition to compose with
262   * @return A trigger which is active when either component trigger is active.
263   */
264  public Trigger or(BooleanSupplier trigger) {
265    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> getAsBoolean() || trigger.getAsBoolean());
266  }
267
268  /**
269   * Creates a new trigger that is active when this trigger is inactive, i.e. that acts as the
270   * negation of this trigger.
271   *
272   * @return the negated trigger
273   */
274  public Trigger negate() {
275    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> !getAsBoolean());
276  }
277
278  /**
279   * Creates a new debounced trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger has
280   * been active for longer than the specified period.
281   *
282   * @param duration The debounce period.
283   * @return The debounced trigger (rising edges debounced only)
284   */
285  public Trigger debounce(Time duration) {
286    return debounce(duration, Debouncer.DebounceType.RISING);
287  }
288
289  /**
290   * Creates a new debounced trigger from this trigger - it will become active when this trigger has
291   * been active for longer than the specified period.
292   *
293   * @param duration The debounce period.
294   * @param type The debounce type.
295   * @return The debounced trigger.
296   */
297  public Trigger debounce(Time duration, Debouncer.DebounceType type) {
298    var debouncer = new Debouncer(duration.in(Seconds), type);
299    return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> debouncer.calculate(getAsBoolean()));
300  }
301
302  /**
303   * Creates a trigger that activates on a rising edge of this trigger's signal. The rising edge
304   * trigger is active in the same cycle that this trigger's condition is {@code true} while its
305   * condition in the previous cycle was {@code false}. The resulting trigger will only be active
306   * for that single cycle before going inactive again; therefore, {@link #onTrue(Command)} should
307   * be used instead of {@link #whileTrue(Command)}, as commands bound using the latter method will
308   * be immediately canceled after a single scheduler cycle.
309   *
310   * @return A rising edge trigger.
311   */
312  public Trigger risingEdge() {
313    return new Trigger(
314        m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH && m_previousSignal == Signal.LOW);
315  }
316
317  /**
318   * Creates a trigger that activates on a falling edge of this trigger's signal. The falling edge
319   * trigger is active in the same cycle that this trigger's condition is {@code false} while its
320   * condition in the previous cycle was {@code true}. The resulting trigger will only be active for
321   * that single cycle before going inactive again; therefore, {@link #onTrue(Command)} should be
322   * used instead of {@link #whileTrue(Command)}, as commands bound using the latter method will be
323   * immediately canceled after a single scheduler cycle.
324   *
325   * @return A falling edge trigger.
326   */
327  public Trigger fallingEdge() {
328    return new Trigger(
329        m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> m_cachedSignal == Signal.LOW && m_previousSignal == Signal.HIGH);
330  }
331
332  /**
333   * Creates a trigger that activates when this trigger has at least {@code pressCount} rising edges
334   * within the specified duration.
335   *
336   * @param pressCount The number of rising edges to require. If this is non-positive, the trigger
337   *     will always be active.
338   * @param duration The duration within which the rising edges must occur. If this is non-positive,
339   *     the trigger will never activate.
340   * @return A trigger that activates on multiple presses
341   */
342  public Trigger multiPress(int pressCount, Time duration) {
343    requireNonNullParam(duration, "duration", "multiTap");
344
345    // Short circuits to avoid unnecessary state tracking and object allocations
346    if (duration.baseUnitMagnitude() <= 0) {
347      // A nonpositive window size can never be met
348      return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> false);
349    } else if (pressCount <= 0) {
350      // A nonpositive press count is always met
351      return new Trigger(m_scheduler, m_loop, () -> true);
352    }
353
354    final double durationSeconds = duration.in(Seconds);
355
356    return new Trigger(
357        m_scheduler,
358        m_loop,
359        new BooleanSupplier() {
360          // Note: unlike EdgeCounterFilter, this implementation tracks timestamps directly
361          // and remains high even if the signal is low, just as long as the number of rising edges
362          // meets the criteria. EdgeCounterFilter is only high when the requisite number of edges
363          // have been seen _and_ the signal is high.
364          private final Deque<Double> m_timestamps = new ArrayDeque<>();
365          private boolean m_risingEdgeOccurred = false;
366
367          @Override
368          public boolean getAsBoolean() {
369            if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH && m_previousSignal != Signal.HIGH) {
370              if (!m_risingEdgeOccurred) {
371                m_timestamps.addLast(Timer.getTimestamp());
372                m_risingEdgeOccurred = true;
373              }
374            } else if (m_cachedSignal != Signal.HIGH) {
375              m_risingEdgeOccurred = false;
376            }
377
378            double currentTime = Timer.getTimestamp();
379            while (!m_timestamps.isEmpty()
380                && currentTime - m_timestamps.peekFirst() > durationSeconds + 1e-9) {
381              m_timestamps.removeFirst();
382            }
383
384            return m_timestamps.size() >= pressCount;
385          }
386        });
387  }
388
389  private void poll() {
390    // Clear bindings that no longer need to run
391    // This should always be checked, regardless of signal change, since bindings may be scoped
392    // and those scopes may become inactive.
393    clearStaleBindings();
394
395    m_previousSignal = m_cachedSignal;
396    m_cachedSignal = readSignal();
397
398    // Always attempt to schedule bindings based on the current signal
399    if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH) {
400      scheduleBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH);
401    } else if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.LOW) {
402      scheduleBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_LOW);
403    }
404
405    if (m_cachedSignal == m_previousSignal) {
406      // No change in the signal. Nothing to do
407      return;
408    }
409
410    if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.HIGH) {
411      // Signal is now high when it wasn't before - a rising edge
412      scheduleBindings(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_RISING_EDGE);
413      scheduleBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_HIGH);
414      cancelBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_LOW);
415      cancelBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_LOW);
416      toggleBindings(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_RISING_EDGE);
417    }
418
419    if (m_cachedSignal == Signal.LOW) {
420      // Signal is now low when it wasn't before - a falling edge
421      scheduleBindings(BindingType.SCHEDULE_ON_FALLING_EDGE);
422      scheduleBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_LOW);
423      cancelBindings(BindingType.RUN_WHILE_HIGH);
424      cancelBindings(BindingType.CONTINUOUSLY_SCHEDULE_WHILE_HIGH);
425      toggleBindings(BindingType.TOGGLE_ON_FALLING_EDGE);
426    }
427  }
428
429  private Signal readSignal() {
430    if (m_condition.getAsBoolean()) {
431      return Signal.HIGH;
432    } else {
433      return Signal.LOW;
434    }
435  }
436
437  /** Removes bindings in inactive scopes. Running commands tied to those bindings are canceled. */
438  private void clearStaleBindings() {
439    m_bindings.forEach(
440        (_bindingType, bindings) -> {
441          for (var iterator = bindings.iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
442            var binding = iterator.next();
443            if (binding.scope().active()) {
444              // This binding's scope is still active, leave it running
445              continue;
446            }
447
448            // The scope is no longer active. Remove the binding and immediately cancel its command.
449            iterator.remove();
450            m_scheduler.cancel(binding.command());
451          }
452        });
453  }
454
455  /**
456   * Schedules all commands bound to the given binding type.
457   *
458   * @param bindingType the binding type to schedule
459   */
460  private void scheduleBindings(BindingType bindingType) {
461    m_bindings.getOrDefault(bindingType, List.of()).forEach(m_scheduler::schedule);
462  }
463
464  /**
465   * Cancels all commands bound to the given binding type.
466   *
467   * @param bindingType the binding type to cancel
468   */
469  private void cancelBindings(BindingType bindingType) {
470    m_bindings
471        .getOrDefault(bindingType, List.of())
472        .forEach(binding -> m_scheduler.cancel(binding.command()));
473  }
474
475  /**
476   * Toggles all commands bound to the given binding type. If a command is currently scheduled or
477   * running, it will be canceled; otherwise, it will be scheduled.
478   *
479   * @param bindingType the binding type to cancel
480   */
481  private void toggleBindings(BindingType bindingType) {
482    m_bindings
483        .getOrDefault(bindingType, List.of())
484        .forEach(
485            binding -> {
486              var command = binding.command();
487              if (m_scheduler.isScheduledOrRunning(command)) {
488                m_scheduler.cancel(command);
489              } else {
490                m_scheduler.schedule(binding);
491              }
492            });
493  }
494
495  /**
496   * Package-private for testing. Reads the signal of the trigger as it was <i>after</i> the most
497   * recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null.
498   *
499   * @return The most recent signal.
500   */
501  Signal getCachedSignal() {
502    return m_cachedSignal;
503  }
504
505  /**
506   * Package-private for testing. Reads the signal of the trigger as it was <i>before</i> the most
507   * recent call to {@link #poll()}. May be null.
508   *
509   * @return The previous signal.
510   */
511  Signal getPreviousSignal() {
512    return m_previousSignal;
513  }
514
515  /** Checks if the creation scope is currently active. */
516  // package-private for the scheduler to access
517  boolean isScopeActive() {
518    return m_creationScope.active();
519  }
520
521  /**
522   * Unbinds this trigger from the event loop and clears all command bindings; any bound commands
523   * that are currently running will be canceled. The trigger may be garbage collected if no other
524   * references exist in user code. Binding a command to a trigger via {@link #onTrue(Command)} or
525   * similar will re-bind the trigger to the event loop.
526   *
527   * <p>Note: because triggers are only updated when they're bound to an event loop, calling {@code
528   * #unbind()} will result in {@link #getAsBoolean()} continuing to return the same value until the
529   * trigger is re-bound.
530   *
531   * <p>This method is automatically called by the associated {@link Scheduler} when the trigger's
532   * creation scope becomes inactive: a trigger created inside a command will be unbound when that
533   * command completes, and may be eligible for garbage collection; and a trigger created while an
534   * opmode is running will be unbound when that opmode ends (and also may be eligible for garbage
535   * collection).
536   */
537  public void unbind() {
538    // Ensure all bound commands are canceled
539    m_bindings.forEach(
540        (_, bindings) -> {
541          bindings.forEach(binding -> m_scheduler.cancel(binding.command()));
542        });
543    m_bindings.clear();
544    m_loop.unbind(m_eventLoopCallback); // note: ConcurrentModificationException if called in poll()
545    m_bound = false;
546  }
547
548  // package-private for testing
549  void addBinding(BindingScope scope, BindingType bindingType, Command command) {
550    // Note: we use a throwable here instead of Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace() for easier
551    //       stack frame filtering and modification.
552    m_bindings
553        .computeIfAbsent(bindingType, _k -> new ArrayList<>())
554        .add(new Binding(scope, bindingType, command, new Throwable().getStackTrace()));
555
556    if (!m_bound) {
557      // Ensure we're bound to the event loop.
558      // Otherwise, the command binding will never fire.
559      m_loop.bind(m_eventLoopCallback);
560      m_bound = true;
561    }
562  }
563
564  private void addBinding(BindingType bindingType, Command command) {
565    var scope = BindingScope.createNarrowestScope(m_scheduler);
566    addBinding(scope, bindingType, command);
567  }
568}
